name: repository-harness
description: Harness validation manifest for the selected Maven installation slice. It contains only stack-relevant add-ons plus shared structural checks.

filePresence.description: Every path in parameters.paths MUST exist as a regular file under the target repository root.

messages.default: missing file: {path}

directoryPresence.description: Every path in parameters.paths MUST exist as a directory under the target repository root.

messages.default: missing directory: {path}

emptyDirectoryPlaceholders.description: Each directory in parameters.directories MUST contain at least one real file or a .gitkeep placeholder.

messages.default: empty directory must keep placeholder or real files: {directory}

templateGroups.description: Each group in parameters.groups MUST exist as a directory under parameters.targetRoot.

messages.default: missing template group: {targetRoot}/{group}

docHeadings.description: Each authored .md file derived from parameters.sourceFilesFromCategory.paths and matching parameters.sourceFilter MUST contain every heading in parameters.headings.

messages.default: doc missing {heading}: {file}

docContent.description: For each entry in parameters.checks, files are concatenated with newlines and evaluated against a condition/when expression. Conditions support string contains checks, allOf (AND), anyOf (OR), contains, and not; nested objects define precedence, explicit empty anyOf fails.

checks.failureMessage: root contract (CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md resolve to one document) must contain Repository Harness Contract
root contract must contain an Entry Point section
root contract must reference AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md resolving to the same document via a symlink in one direction
root contract must describe docs/generated/ semantics
repository docs must describe generated-artifact source command and regeneration trigger metadata
root contract must state that the harness may evolve across development phases

agentFrontmatter.description: Every .md file directly under parameters.directory MUST start with parameters.frontmatterStart and contain every field in parameters.requiredFields. The `name` value MUST match parameters.namePattern.

messages.missingDirectory: .claude/agents must contain at least one .md agent

skillFrontmatter.description: Every file named parameters.filename under parameters.rootDirectory (any depth) MUST start with parameters.frontmatterStart and contain every field in parameters.requiredFields.

messages.missingDirectory: .claude/skills must contain at least one SKILL.md

scaffoldLeaks.description: Scan every file under parameters.scope.bases (excluding excludedSubtrees and files whose extension is not in extensions) and emit a finding for every regex match in parameters.patterns.

messages.default: {label} in active asset: {file}

hookShebang.description: Each hook in parameters.hooks MUST start with the line in parameters.expectedShebang.

messages.default: {hook} must start with {expectedShebang}

hookExecutable.description: Each hook in parameters.hooks MUST have its executable bit set on disk.

messages.default: {hook} must be executable

hookGeneratedMarker.description: Each hook in parameters.hooks MUST contain parameters.markerTemplate (with {name} substituted) and MUST NOT contain parameters.placeholderForbidden.

parameters.placeholderForbidden: packaged placeholder is replaced during harness installation

hookStage.description: Each hook MUST contain parameters.markerTemplate with {stage} substituted from parameters.stages[<hookName>]. Hook names are pre-commit and pre-push.

messages.default: {hook} must contain stage marker '# Harness stage: {expectedStage}'

hookCommand.description: parameters.prePushHook MUST declare and run a command listed in parameters.allowedCommands. When parameters.allowedPreCommitCommands is non-empty, parameters.preCommitHook MUST also declare and run one of those commands; otherwise pre-commit MUST NOT run any full-stack validation command.

messages.commandNotRun: {hook} must run the declared validation command
messages.preCommitMustNotRunFullStack: pre-commit hook must not run full stack validation commands

ciHookCommandParity.description: Each existing file in parameters.ciFiles MUST contain the validation command declared by parameters.referenceHook. Absent files are skipped.

messages.default: {ciFile}: CI command mismatch — expected {command}

envShebangUsage.description: Any executable script under parameters.directories whose first line starts with `#!` MUST start with parameters.expectedPrefix.

messages.default: executable script should use /usr/bin/env shebang: {file}

uncheckedTasks.description: Every file matching parameters.filenamePattern under parameters.directory MUST NOT contain any line matching parameters.uncheckedTaskPattern. Enforces that plans moved into directory have all tasks marked done.

messages.default: completed plan has unchecked tasks: {file}

symlinkSafety.description: All scanned files and directories MUST NOT be symbolic links, except symlinks within parameters.allowedSymlinkPairs (root contract symlinks).

messages.scanRootNotAllowed: symlink scan root is not allowed: {path}
messages.scanEntryNotAllowed: symlink scan entry is not allowed: {path}

greaterThanComparison.description: Source files under parameters.sourceRoots MUST NOT use `>` or `>=` comparison operators; smaller value always belongs on the left (`<` / `<=`). Validators implement this via Java JavaParser. Files under `parameters.sourceRoots` are scanned; `parameters.includePaths` further narrows the set (empty array means match-all) and `parameters.excludePaths` removes matches. Globs use Ant-style `**/*` semantics relative to the project root.

messages.default: forbidden `>`/`>=` comparison; rewrite with `<`/`<=` so the smaller value is on the left

leafFunctionBlankLines.description: Leaf functions (function bodies that do not contain any nested function or lambda) under parameters.sourceRoots MUST NOT contain more than one consecutive blank line. Outer functions that contain nested functions are exempt. Validators implement this via AST. The allowed blank-line run length is controlled by parameters.maxConsecutiveBlankLines. Files under `parameters.sourceRoots` are scanned; `parameters.includePaths` further narrows the set (empty array means match-all) and `parameters.excludePaths` removes matches. Globs use Ant-style `**/*` semantics relative to the project root.

messages.default: leaf function `{function}` contains too many blank lines; remove or extract the section

earlyReturn.description: Functions under parameters.sourceRoots MUST have a single exit point. `return` is allowed only as the final statement of the function body, or inside a `guard`-style fail-fast helper. Validators implement this via AST: visit every function declaration, walk the body, and emit a finding for any `return` that is not the last statement (or inside a top-level guard clause that throws). Files under `parameters.sourceRoots` are scanned; `parameters.includePaths` further narrows the set (empty array means match-all) and `parameters.excludePaths` removes matches. Globs use Ant-style `**/*` semantics relative to the project root.

messages.default: function `{function}` has an early/mid return; restructure with single exit

silentCatch.description: `try`/`catch` blocks under parameters.sourceRoots MUST NOT swallow exceptions. The catch block MUST either rethrow, translate to a `Finding`, or log via the structured logger. Empty or `pass`-only catch blocks are forbidden. Validators implement this via AST. Files under `parameters.sourceRoots` are scanned; `parameters.includePaths` further narrows the set (empty array means match-all) and `parameters.excludePaths` removes matches. Globs use Ant-style `**/*` semantics relative to the project root.

messages.default: silent catch; rethrow, translate to a Finding, or log via structured logger

unstructuredLogging.description: Code under parameters.sourceRoots MUST log via the structured logger only. Forbidden: Java `System.out.println` / `System.err.println`. Use Slf4j or java.util.logging. Validators implement this via AST. Files under `parameters.sourceRoots` are scanned; `parameters.includePaths` further narrows the set (empty array means match-all) and `parameters.excludePaths` removes matches. Globs use Ant-style `**/*` semantics relative to the project root.

messages.default: unstructured logging `{snippet}`; use structured logger

wildcardImport.description: Code under parameters.sourceRoots MUST use explicit per-symbol imports. Forbidden: Java `import foo.bar.*`. Validators implement this via AST. Files under `parameters.sourceRoots` are scanned; `parameters.includePaths` further narrows the set (empty array means match-all) and `parameters.excludePaths` removes matches. Globs use Ant-style `**/*` semantics relative to the project root.

messages.default: wildcard import `{import}` forbidden; import explicit symbols

importOverFqn.description: Code under parameters.sourceRoots MUST reach external symbols via `import` rather than inline fully qualified names, EXCEPT when the simple name is already taken by another import in the same file (i.e. the FQN is required to disambiguate). Validators implement this via AST/CST: collect every imported simple name first, then emit a finding when a qualified type reference appears in code AND the qualified name's simple form is NOT already imported under a different qualified name. Files under `parameters.sourceRoots` are scanned; `parameters.includePaths` further narrows the set (empty array means match-all) and `parameters.excludePaths` removes matches. Globs use Ant-style `**/*` semantics relative to the project root.

messages.default: fully qualified name `{name}` used inline; add an import and use the simple name

publicDeclarationDocComment.description: Every externally visible declaration under parameters.sourceRoots MUST carry a documentation comment in JavaDoc form. Validators implement this via AST: walk top-level public/exported declarations and emit a finding for missing doc comments. Files under `parameters.sourceRoots` are scanned; `parameters.includePaths` further narrows the set (empty array means match-all) and `parameters.excludePaths` removes matches. Globs use Ant-style `**/*` semantics relative to the project root. Declarations matching one of `parameters.visibility` are required to carry a documentation comment. Valid tokens per stack are listed in the references doc; default values preserve pre-Wave-3 behavior.

messages.default: public declaration `{name}` is missing a documentation comment

leadingUnderscore.description: Java source files under parameters.sourceRoots MUST NOT use leading underscores in file basenames or declarations. The discard name `_` and configured allowedNames or allowedPatterns are exempt. Files under `parameters.sourceRoots` are scanned; `parameters.includePaths` further narrows the set (empty array means match-all) and `parameters.excludePaths` removes matches. Globs use Ant-style `**/*` semantics relative to the project root.

messages.default: declaration `{name}` uses a leading underscore

multilineDocStyle.description: JavaDoc comments under parameters.sourceRoots MUST use multiline block style. This aligns with googleJavaFormat-compatible native JavaDoc. Files under `parameters.sourceRoots` are scanned; `parameters.includePaths` further narrows the set (empty array means match-all) and `parameters.excludePaths` removes matches.

messages.default: documentation comment must use multiline JavaDoc style

emptyCatchBlock.description: Catch handlers under parameters.sourceRoots MUST have a non-empty body. Empty catch handlers are a special case of silentCatch and are listed separately for clarity. Validators implement this via AST. Files under `parameters.sourceRoots` are scanned; `parameters.includePaths` further narrows the set (empty array means match-all) and `parameters.excludePaths` removes matches. Globs use Ant-style `**/*` semantics relative to the project root.

messages.default: empty catch block; handle, rethrow, or convert to a Finding

ifStatementBraces.description: Every `if` / `else if` / `else` clause under parameters.sourceRoots MUST use a braced block (`{ ... }`), even for single-statement bodies. Validators implement this via AST/CST. Files under `parameters.sourceRoots` are scanned; `parameters.includePaths` further narrows the set (empty array means match-all) and `parameters.excludePaths` removes matches. Globs use Ant-style `**/*` semantics relative to the project root.

messages.default: if/else without braces; wrap the body in `{ ... }`

classMemberOrdering.description: Java class bodies under parameters.sourceRoots MUST keep ordinary members in parameters.kindOrder, parameters.visibilityOrder, and parameters.overrideOrder. Java enum constants are language-mandated preamble items and are not sorted as ordinary members. Validators implement this via AST. Files under `parameters.sourceRoots` are scanned; `parameters.includePaths` further narrows the set (empty array means match-all) and `parameters.excludePaths` removes matches. Globs use Ant-style `**/*` semantics relative to the project root.

messages.default: class `{className}` member `{memberName}` ({memberOverrideState}:{memberVisibility}:{memberKind}) is out of order

uncheckedCastSuppression.description: Java code under parameters.sourceRoots MUST NOT use @SuppressWarnings annotations with forbidden tokens. Detects all argument forms: positional single/multiple, named array/single. Refactor to use type-safe casts or explicit handling. Validators implement this via AST. Files under `parameters.sourceRoots` are scanned; `parameters.includePaths` further narrows the set (empty array means match-all) and `parameters.excludePaths` removes matches. Globs use Ant-style `**/*` semantics relative to the project root.

messages.default: avoid suppression of forbidden tokens (`{snippet}`); refactor to type-safe cast or explicit handling

seedFiles.description: Optional placeholder files the harness installs but the target repository MAY replace, rename, or remove. Not a check.

generatedArtifacts.description: Policy for docs/generated/. Not a check.
generatedArtifacts.policy: Place actual generated repository artifacts here. Do not add fake placeholder files; keep the directory empty with .gitkeep until a real generation step exists.

harnessEvolution.description: Policy for how the harness evolves. Not a check. The harness is not versioned — the current committed state is the only authoritative shape.
harnessEvolution.policy: The in-repository harness may evolve across discovery, implementation, hardening, release, and maintenance. The current committed harness is the active contract; no schemaVersion, no retired keys, no alternate compatibility paths.

teamPatterns.description: Catalog of team/agent collaboration patterns this harness recognises. Not a check.
